title: Depth-Recurrent Attention Mixture (Dreamer): Giving Latent Reasoning the Attention it Deserves
abstract: arXiv:2601.21582v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Depth-recurrence facilitates latent reasoning by sharing parameters across depths. However, prior work lacks combined FLOP-, parameter-, and memory-matched baselines, underutilizes depth-recurrence due to partially fixed layer stacks, and ignores the bottleneck of constant hidden-sizes that restricts many-step latent reasoning. To address this, we introduce a modular framework of depth-recurrent attention mixtures (Dreamer), combining sequence attention, depth attention, and sparse expert attention. It alleviates the hidden-size bottleneck through attention along depth, decouples scaling dimensions, and allows depth-recurrent models to scale efficiently and effectively. Across language reasoning benchmarks, our models require 2 to 8x fewer training tokens for the same accuracy as FLOP-, parameter-, and memory-matched SOTA, and outperform ca. 2x larger SOTA models with the same training tokens. translated_title: 深度循环注意力混合： 让潜在推理得到应有的关注
translated_abstract: 深度循环通过跨深度共享参数来促进潜在推理。然而，先前的工作缺乏同时匹配FLOP、参数量和内存的基线对比，由于部分固定的层堆叠而未充分利用深度循环，并且忽略了限制多步潜在推理的恒定隐藏维度瓶颈。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一个深度循环注意力混合的模块化框架，结合了序列注意力、深度注意力和稀疏专家注意力。该框架通过沿深度方向的注意力缓解了隐藏维度瓶颈，解耦了各缩放维度，使深度循环模型能够高效且有效地扩展。在语言推理基准测试中，我们的模型在与FLOP、参数量和内存均匹配的SOTA模型达到相同精度时，所需训练token减少2到8倍，并在相同训练token数量下优于约2倍规模的SOTA模型。我们还进一步提供了关于知识的洞见……
tldr: 该论文提出Dreamer模块化框架，通过结合序列注意力、深度注意力和稀疏专家注意力来突破恒定隐藏维度的瓶颈，使深度循环模型在语言推理基准上以2-8倍更少的训练token达到与SOTA相当的精度，并优于约2倍规模的SOTA模型。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Dreamer, a modular framework combining sequence attention, depth attention, and sparse expert attention to overcome the hidden-size bottleneck, enabling depth-recurrent models to match SOTA accuracy with 2-8x fewer training tokens and outperform roughly 2x larger SOTA models on language reasoning benchmarks.
